paragraphs.text: Tom and Ben are good friends. They like to run in the park every day.
One morning, Ben says, “Let’s have a race!” Tom smiles and says, “Ready, set, go!”
Ben runs very fast. Tom runs more slowly, but he does not stop. He keeps going until he reaches the tree.
Ben wins the race, but he waits for Tom. “You did not give up,” Ben says. Tom smiles. They walk home together, happy to be friends.
